flags.description: Post-stream clipper (services/clip/clipper.py): ranked candidates, 3 vertical variants, captions, validation. Off until used on a real stream.
Chat-driven effects and event-driven animated layers (example; off until used on a real stream).
Export-only posting (P16a): review packages of validated clips (video, cover, text) on the Posts view. Nothing is uploaded.
Bot manager (BM1, D193): the Bots card starts, shows and stops the user's installed Streamer.bot and Speaker.bot; only bots Ujwalam started are stopped, also when the studio stops.

Test broadcast banner (BM3, D196): a short on-screen note on H and V at stream start and every 15 minutes, telling viewers this is a test of new streaming software. Switches live: the page polls the overlay server every 5 s; off hides it at once.

Report button (D199): the control page opens a prefilled GitHub new-issue page in your browser (title, version, OS, flags, counts-only diagnostics). Needs links.issues_url in the local profile. Nothing is sent by Ujwalam; you review and submit in the browser.
